mapper.select: SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.org_id, up.is_primary, up.position, up.remark, up.created_at, up.updated_at, o.name AS org_name, o.path AS org_path, o.org_type FROM sys_user_position up JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = up.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_user_position, alias=up) */ AND up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, o.path ASC, up.id ASC
